title: Skills
description: The keeper's level and what it buys. Guests served earn experience by how they liked it; each level up gives a point to spend in the Skills screen at the desk, on recipes or knacks. Dishes that are bought in (ale, cider, bought snacks) need no recipe.

startKnown.description: Dish ids a new keeper knows.

xpPerServe.description: Experience for a guest served, by how they took it. Outcomes not listed earn nothing.

levels.description: Experience to level up: `first` for the first level, and each level after needs `step` more than the one before.

recipes.description: Dishes that can be learned, and what each costs.

knacks.description: Things the keeper gets better at, bought a tier at a time. `value` is what a tier does: for quickHands, how long wiping takes (times the usual); for charm, pence added to every tip; for keenEye, the share of the day's wear still paid; for gentleHands, how fast equipment loses health (times the usual); for handy, the share of its health a piece you mend yourself gets back.
